title: Android build 18 ready: responsive remote and saved return
summary: Signed Android 1.0.16/build 18 is packaged and checked. It restores the last page and approved direct connection, supports capture resizing, and retries an unavailable viewer automatically. Physical two-phone acceptance remains untested.

changes.detail: Package signed arm64 Android 1.0.16 / build 18 with compact portrait/landscape viewer, native capture resize, encrypted host pairing and saved page restoration. Install on both phones to receive the full native change.

Retry a failed WebView load every five seconds while the viewer is active. Explicit direct Disconnect waits for host confirmation, keeps the saved session available for retry when unreachable, and reads a saved token if the viewer has not loaded it yet.

Document Android capture-consent requirements after sharing-phone power-off/lock/revocation and distinguish page/pairing restoration from uninterrupted screen capture. Preserve all earlier immutable reports.

validation.name: Automated regression checks
validation.detail: TypeScript and focused ESLint passed. Viewer/history/storage/route suite: 19 passed, with a subsequently added rotation-gesture test passing in the final 12-test focused run. Owner session: 9 passed. The final viewer interaction test additionally passed automatic retry, failed-disconnect retention and successful-disconnect clearing.

validation.name: Native Android checks and APK
validation.detail: 11 native server tests passed with zero failures/errors in debug and release. Final release build succeeded in 1m 37s. Version 1.0.16/code 18 and arm64 verified; signature matches earlier build 11; encrypted pairing, resize methods, navigation restoration, camera, QR consent and recovery are packaged. Viewer assets match workspace source byte-for-byte; final staged source matches workspace. Expo runtime resource is 1.0.16. SHA256: 7de5f7f37ac4668a64505baf8c87cdc515d294d9606853cae05024b71ba3260a.

validation.name: Layout and package inspection
validation.detail: Four headless Edge viewport/frame orientation combinations passed with Arabic controls, maintained image proportions, no clipping/overflow and no browser errors; synthetic screenshots inspected. All 1403 APK ZIP entries passed known private-value, common credential-pattern and private-file checks. This is not proof against unknown or encoded secrets.

validation.name: History retention
validation.detail: Append command preserved earlier reports; history checker passed before this final append and will run again after it. APK includes initial and automated-verification reports; this post-build report is stored in workspace history for the next build.

validation.name: Device acceptance and delivery
validation.detail: No physical two-phone testing, APK installation, OTA or public deployment. Real rotation/touch, Android Keystore/reboot, lock/unlock, capture restart, network changes, background/overnight service survival and OEM behavior remain untested. Android requires fresh capture consent when the sharing capture ends; no connection operates while a phone is off. Cold login still validates remembered credentials and honors revocation. Hosted relay sessions retain their existing lifetime.
